subject: maths
question: A sum becomes 8 times in 9 years at compound interest. In how many years will it become 64 times?
solution:
**Given:**

A sum becomes 8 times in 9 years at compound interest

Required: Time to become 64 times

**Formula used:**

A = P × (1 + r)t

**Calculations:**

8 = (1 + r)⁹

⇒ 8 = 2³

⇒ (1 + r)⁹ = 2³

⇒ (1 + r) = 2¹/³

**For 64 times:**

64 = (1 + r)t

⇒ 64 = 2⁶

⇒ (2¹/³)t = 2⁶

⇒ 2t/³ = 2⁶

⇒ t ÷ 3 = 6

⇒ t = 18 years

**∴ The sum will become 64 times in 18 years.**
